hook: Thieves stole 30,000 bottles of wine worth $8 million in a single night.

sections.voiceover: Thieves stole 30,000 bottles of wine worth $8 million in a single night.
b_roll: Exterior shot of a wine warehouse in Cortona, Tuscany
Close-up of wine bottles on storage racks

sections.voiceover: Masked men emptied a Marchesi Antinori facility in Cortona during a 3-hour operation. Two trucks hauled away prized Tignanello and Solaia red wines from the property. Where did the 2 trucks go?
b_roll: Security camera footage showing masked figures
Loading dock with truck parked outside

sections.voiceover: But security alarms at the Marchesi Antinori facility were switched off from the inside.
b_roll: Close-up of security control panel flashing red

sections.voiceover: Carabinieri from the Cortona company reviewed footage from over 100 security cameras. Investigators tracked the stolen goods valued up to 5 million euros.
Guado al Tasso bottles vanished into the Tuscan night during the three-hour operation.
b_roll: Wine bottle label reading Guado al Tasso against a dark background
